name: git-flow
description: Plugin that turns every code change into a clean, reviewable update on GitHub.

interface.shortDescription: Branch → pull request → wait for checks → land, one branch per change.
interface.longDescription: Modelize plugin that turns every code change into a clean, reviewable update on GitHub. Creates an isolated branch, runs a local check against the working tree, opens a pull request, waits for the required checks, and lands the change automatically. Exposes slash commands (/branch, /pr, /watch, /merge, /status, /back-to-main, /setup-ci) for fine-grained control. /setup-ci is opt-in and scaffolds a minimal GitHub Actions workflow when the repo has none. GitHub-only; uses `gh` and `git` directly.
